issues.failure_explanation: The paper computes the integral of two Gaussians with the same scale σ and claims it equals (σ^{2s}/(2σ)^d)·φ̂((x−x')/(2σ)). Direct computation shows the correct result is (σ^{2s−d}/(|D_1|(√2)^d))·φ̂((x−x')/(√2σ)): the Gaussian argument should involve √2·σ (the geometric-mean convolution scale), not 2σ, and the |D_1| denominator is incorrectly dropped. Two independent errors in the displayed formula.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the convolution identity to use √2·σ in the Gaussian argument and retain the |D_1| and (√2)^d normalization factors.
issues.overall_effect: The specific closed-form formula for the GP kernel derived from the feature function is wrong. The qualitative conclusion (the kernel is Gaussian with a fixed scale) survives.
issues.title: GP kernel convolution formula has wrong Gaussian scale and normalization
issues.why_classification: A short, local correction to the displayed formula preserves every substantive claim and guarantee; the qualitative conclusion (Gaussian kernel) is unaffected.

The claim needs density in the Sobolev space U_o (e.g., H²(D)), which requires approximating first and second derivatives simultaneously — a strictly stronger statement. issues.failure_explanation: Assumption assu:embedding requires the SAME embedding chain (either (1) F_o→L²_λ→F or (2) F_o→F→L²_λ) on the entire product space F = F_D × F_∂D. For the running example F = H⁻¹(D)×H^{1/2}(∂D), L²_λ = L²(D)×L²(∂D): on D condition (1) holds (L²→L²→H⁻¹) but on ∂D only condition (2) holds (H^{3/2}→H^{1/2}→L²). Neither uniform condition holds on the product, so the assumption is not satisfied. The remark acknowledges this but the formal assumption is not generalized.
